character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Create a 2D pixel art jump animation for the same pigeon character used in my retro platformer game.  Character: A small urban pigeon hero in side view, facing right, with a gray body, darker head, small orange eye, orange legs, and a simple readable pixel-art silhouette.  Animation goal: This is NOT full flying. This is a platformer jump animation. When the pigeon jumps, it should briefly flap or open its wings to stay airborne. The motion should feel like a short jump with a bird-like airborne pose.  Style: Retro 2D pixel art, game-ready, transparent background, 32x32 sprite proportions, same character design, same palette, consistent scale and silhouette, no background, no extra objects.  Please generate frames for: - jump start - rising in air - apex - falling  Use a clean side-view platformer style. Keep the pigeon readable and consistent with the base sprite.
